user

Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**FADE IN:**

**INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY**

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all is 127-year-old MANUEL, dressed in a tailored suit, beaming with pride. A plaque is placed in front of him, reading "Oldest Human to Ever Live".

**OFFICIAL** (holding a microphone)
Ladies and gentlemen, it is our great honor to present to you the world record holder for the longest human lifespan, the incomparable Manuel!

**CROWD ERUPTS IN APPLAUSE**

Manuel smiles, tears of joy welling up in his eyes. He shakes hands with the officials, takes photos with reporters, and basks in the admiration of the crowd.

**CUT TO:**

**INT. MANUEL'S BEDROOM - NIGHT**

Manuel lies in bed, surrounded by family photos and mementos from a lifetime. He gazes up at the ceiling, lost in thought. Suddenly, his eyes land on a small, dusty book on his nightstand.

**MANUEL** (whispering to himself)
Quantum Immortality... I remember reading about it in a forum online...

He picks up the book, blowing off the dust. The pages reveal a theory that had fascinated him as a young man: the idea that, according to quantum mechanics, every time a person dies, the universe splits into multiple parallel universes, each with a different outcome.

**MANUEL** (voice rising)
If that's true... if every time I died, I was reborn in a different universe... then I must be... (he gasps)...immortal!

**CUT TO:**

**MANUEL'S MIND**

We see a kaleidoscope of images: Manuel's life unfolding in multiple parallel universes. He sees himself as a young man, falling in love, having children, growing old. But in each universe, he dies, only to be reborn in a new reality.

**MANUEL** (screaming)
I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO'S LIVED FOREVER! I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO'S SEEN EVERY POSSIBLE OUTCOME!

**CUT TO:**

**INT. MANUEL'S BEDROOM - NIGHT**

Manuel's body begins to shake, his eyes wild with madness. He throws the book across the room, shattering it into pieces.

**MANUEL** (whispering, his voice barely audible)
I'M NOT ALIVE... I'M JUST A PARALLEL UNIVERSE... A SIMULATION...

**CUT TO:**

**BLACKNESS**

The camera lingers on Manuel's face, his eyes frozen in terror, as the sound of his own screams fade into the darkness.

**FADE TO BLACK.**
